Blast off! A space printable coloring book with 24 big, simple pages: a child astronaut floating among the stars, a rocket launch, Saturn and its rings, a friendly alien and its flying saucer, a moon rover, an astronaut cat, a space dog, a robot friend, a UFO beaming up a cow and a capsule splashing down at home.

WHAT YOU GET
- 1 PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and 1 PDF in A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
- 25 pages: a full-colour cover + 24 black and white coloring pages, one big illustration per page
- 300 DPI, thick clear outlines, easy to color for kids aged about 4 to 8
